note: Theme-independent structural tokens for Product #001's v3.0 visual system (ADR-018, supersedes the v2.0/ADR-015 'no boxes' editorial system). This is a DIGITAL STATIONERY / PREMIUM PLANNER system: real corner radius, elevation (shadow), card surfaces and a fixed icon set are now first-class structure, not exceptions. render/build.mjs merges this file with the selected theme file into one CSS :root{} custom-properties block; the component stylesheet references var(--token) only, never a literal value.

typography.displayFallback: Playfair Display, 'Iowan Old Style', Georgia, serif
typography.note_numerals: No OpenType tabular-nums feature - breaks PDF text extraction in Chromium (products/001-*/test/QA.md). Right-align + fixed column widths do the alignment work instead.

grid.widthDeltaHandling: US Letter content width exceeds A4 by 5.9mm; absorbed entirely by each page's flexible label/description column(s) and by widening card gutters slightly. Numeric/date/checkbox column widths are identical constants across variants.

borders.note: Hairlines now live INSIDE cards (row dividers in a card-table) and as a card's own quiet outline - never as the page's primary structure. Structure comes from card surfaces + elevation.

radius.rationale: Replaces the v2.0 'no boxes / radius near 0' rule (ADR-015), which the v3.0 visual reset (ADR-018) explicitly retires. Cards/panels use lg (4.5mm); small chips/inputs use sm-md; badges, pills and progress-bar tracks are fully round.

elevation.note: Shadow colour/opacity is theme-defined (design/tokens/themes/*.json shadowColour) so dark themes can use a deeper, more saturated shadow instead of a washed-out one. Verified: Chromium's page.pdf({printBackground:true}) renders box-shadow/border-radius/gradients faithfully - this is the same print pipeline already used for the v2.0 accent hairlines.

header.style: hero band - tinted surface strip behind the title, not a bare hairline rule
